The field is pre-filled with the product configured for the wiki, and is empty ## until an administrator configures one. #if ($product == '' && "$!defaultProduct" == '') {{error}}{{translation key="releasenotes.releases.add.productRequired"/}}{{/error}} #else #try('creationException') #set ($rnPageReference = $services.releasenotes.getReleaseNoteReference($product, $version)) #set ($rnDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($rnPageReference)) ## Whether the version is taken is looked at here, rather than left to the creation to report, so that the ## release note holding it can be named and linked to. #if ($rnDoc.isNew()) #set ($discard = $services.releasenotes.createReleaseNote({'product': $product, 'version': $version})) ## Redirect in edit mode to edit the RN $response.sendRedirect($xwiki.getURL($services.model.serialize($rnPageReference))) #else #set ($versionIsTaken = true) #end #end #if ($versionIsTaken) ## The message names the release note that already exists and links to it: an author who lands here has typed ## a version by hand and needs to see which note that version is taken by. The link sits in the middle of the ## sentence, so its markup is built here and passed as parameters rather than left in the translation value, ## where it would be escaped instead of rendered. #set ($alreadyExistsParameters = [$services.rendering.escape($version, 'xwiki/2.1'), '[[', ">>path:$rnDoc.getURL('view')]]"]) {{error}}$services.localization.render('releasenotes.releases.add.alreadyExists', $alreadyExistsParameters){{/error}} #elseif ($creationException) {{error}}{{translation key="releasenotes.releases.add.failed"/}}{{/error}} #end #end #end ## Both prompts are placeholder attributes and not the inputs' own value: as a value a prompt would give the field ## no accessible name, and an untouched field would name the created release note after the prompt. The product ## input still carries a value because the configured default product name pre-fills it; its placeholder is what ## shows when no default is configured. The version is marked required because the page reference of a release ## note is built from it. {{html}}
